apply.title: BGSU - How to Apply (international undergraduate): fee and deadlines

tuit.title: BGSU - International undergraduate tuition and scholarships

test_policy.notes: SAT/ACT are not required for admission. International applicants must submit one of them only to be considered for merit scholarships (SAT composite of verbal and math, or ACT composite with a competitive English band score).

requirements.notes: International application fee $75, no fee waivers. Requires official secondary transcripts (and any college transcripts) and proof of English; no essays or recommendation letters. Minimum cumulative high school GPA 2.5 on a 4.0 scale. College Navigator lists a $45 undergraduate fee for 2024-25; the international page says $75.

deadlines.label: International deadline: application and all supporting documents (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Stated for Fall 2027 admission. Spring 2027 entry: November 6, 2026.

deadlines.label: Last day BGSU issues I-20s for fall 2027

english_policy.waiver_notes: Applicants may instead complete ELS Intensive English for Academic Purposes Level 112, or attend a high school or other higher education institution that uses English as the primary language of instruction for at least one academic year. The TOEFL MyBest score is not accepted.

english.notes: Page lists 71 for 2025 and before. MyBest not accepted.
Page says 'TOEFL iBT: 4' for 2026 and beyond without naming the 1-6 band scale.

aid.notes: Automatic merit scholarships for international students (no separate application; requires a complete admission application and, for the academic award, SAT/ACT or TOEFL/IELTS-type scores). BG Success Scholarship $4,000/year for all international freshmen and transfers with GPA 3.0+, renewable four years. Freshman Academic Scholarship $1,000 to $8,000/year by GPA and test scores (estimates: $1,000 at GPA 3.0-3.19 with SAT 1050/ACT 21 or TOEFL 71-80; $3,000 at GPA 3.2-3.49, SAT 1160/ACT 25; $5,000 at GPA 3.5-3.69, SAT 1260/ACT 28; $8,000 at GPA 3.7-4.0, SAT 1380/ACT 31). To be considered for fall 2026 the page said apply by June 20, 2026; the fall 2027 date is not yet posted.

cost.notes: BGSU international estimate for 2026-27 at 12 credits: tuition and fees combined $23,500, room and meals $12,500, insurance and books $3,500 (total $39,500). The tuition_intl_usd figure includes required fees. Falcon Tuition Guarantee locks tuition for four years; aviation flight technology costs more. An international student services fee applies each fall and spring (amount not stated on the page).
